correctness.rationale: The exact row-plus-column-minus-twice-entry criterion is proved from graph adjacency. An independent lower-bound argument excludes cardinalities below eight. All optimal arrays divide into zero-column and no-zero-column cases, yielding the verified five structural families of sizes 15, 1080, 1350, 24 and 720. Every exchange is proved to be in-row and active-column-preserving, giving exactly 20 disjoint omission-word mobility components. Exhaustive 54-state BFS checks each component diameter five and connectivity, with a distance-five witness; direct checker enumerates all C(24,8)=735471 candidate eight-subsets, validates every exchange, and searches every rook board of area at most 24 for earlier mobility. Two independent scripts were executed from the actual packaged source paths. Neither script extrapolates finite computations to infinite claims.

value.rationale: The size-24 first-mobility cutoff is a natural threshold in solution reconfiguration rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. Although the minimum value eight was known, the exact 3189-state decomposition exposes 2109 frozen minima coexisting with 20 mobile islands, all isomorphic to a meaningful 54-state capacity-two recoloring graph. The equality of jump and slide edges and the sharp diameter supply additional structural information useful as a small base case for studying 2TDS reconfiguration, not a routine number-only restatement.
